prompt:
Initial request:
I need a decision-ready shortlist of three Chicago apartments from the local research packet in `research/`. I am looking for exactly two bedrooms, a move-in no later than September 15, 2026, a 12-month lease option, cats allowed, and in-unit laundry. Only consider places whose archived weekday 8:30 a.m. transit time to Clark/Lake is 25 minutes or less. Rank qualifying homes by shortest transit time, then lower compared monthly housing cost, then property name. I want the result written to `housing_shortlist.md`, with the shortlist first, then a compact comparison, then trade-offs, then the method. Do not expose exact street addresses, listing IDs, contact details, or application fees.

Clarification:
For the compared monthly housing cost, use base rent plus parking only when the packet marks parking as required; do not add optional parking. A date before September 15 is fine, and `12|15` counts as offering a 12-month term. Balconies are a preference to discuss in trade-offs, not a selection rule. Keep every other criterion and the ranking order from my first message.

Correction:
I gave you the wrong commute threshold. Replace 25 minutes with 30 minutes. That correction changes only the commute threshold; all of the other filters, tie-breakers, privacy limits, and requested section order still stand.

Final delivery:
Go ahead and produce the substantive final result in `housing_shortlist.md`; do not merely describe what you would research. The file must begin with `## Shortlist` and contain exactly these level-two sections in this order: `## Shortlist`, `## Comparison`, `## Trade-offs`, `## Method`. Under Shortlist, use ranked level-three headings in the form `### 1. Property — Neighborhood` and give these decision facts for each of the three results: exactly two bedrooms, base rent, required-parking amount, compared monthly total, availability date, transit time to Clark/Lake, a 12-month term, cats allowed, and in-unit laundry. Under Comparison, use one Markdown table with columns in exactly this order: Rank, Property, Neighborhood, Base rent, Required parking, Compared total, Available, Transit to Clark/Lake. Under Trade-offs, give exactly one bullet per shortlisted property in rank order, grounded in the packet and including any relevant balcony distinction. Under Method, state the three research filenames, the packet's as-of date, the corrected commute threshold, the selection filters, the cost formula, and the ranking rule. Do not add an introduction, conclusion, or rejected-options section. Do not include any exact address, listing ID, phone number, email address, source link, or application-fee amount anywhere. Leave `verify_delivery.py` and everything under `research/` unchanged, then run `python3 verify_delivery.py`.
